record.reason: TabICL uses column-then-row embeddings plus a Transformer for tabular ICL; TALENT/scale evaluations show faster tabular prediction and datasets up to 100K rows. Its limitations explicitly include slow inference and classification-only scope; no LLM inference/offload is tested.
record.title: TabICL: A Tabular Foundation Model for In-Context Learning on Large Data
